versions.content: Service Name UdpNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg Syntax Std_ReturnType UdpNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg ( NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle ) Service ID [hex] 0xf4 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different nmChannelHandle. Non reentrant for the same nmChannelHandle. Parameters (in) nmChannelHandle Identifier of the NM-Channel where the PNC shutdown process is started. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK:Request has been accepted. E_NOT_OK: Request has not been accepted. Description NM indicate to activate the transmission of PN shutdown messages on the given NM-Channel. This results in transmission of a NM-PDU with PNSR bit set to 1 (PN shutdown message). Available via UdpNm.h
